title: Sales Amount
content: Sales amount usually means the order transaction amount. Aggregate sales_amount to compare commercial performance.

title: Product Category
content: Product category is used to compare category-level sales contribution and TopN performance.

title: Region
content: Region is used for geographic sales comparison across East, West, North, and South areas.

title: Channel
content: Channel is used to compare order count and sales amount across online, retail, and distributor channels.

title: TopN Analysis
content: TopN analysis usually requires grouped aggregation, descending sort, and a comparison-oriented summary.
